rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something in an appropriate way.

example.english: If you suitably plan your time, you won’t always be in such a rush.
example.traditional: 你適當噉安排時間，就唔使成日咁趕。
example.jyutping: nei5 sik1 dong3 gam2 on1 paai4 si4 gaan1 zau6 m4 sai2 seng4 jat6 gam3 gon2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on behaving or speaking with propriety and social tact.

example.english: They suitably responded to the guest, and everyone felt at ease.
example.traditional: 佢得體噉回應客人，大家都覺得舒服。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dak1 tai2 gam2 wui4 jing3 haak3 jan4 daai6 gaa1 dou1 gok3 dak1 syu1 fuk6
